title: Unknown URLs send guests to sign-in instead of a 404 page
expected: A mistyped or retired link shows the branded not-found page with status 404.
actual: The edge proxy treats every non-public path, including non-existent ones, as protected and redirects to /login?return=….
impact: Broken shared links look like a login wall; search engines see redirects instead of 404s.
fix: Redirect only known protected route prefixes (an allow-list of app routes) and let everything else fall through to not-found.
